# BlogHub

> BlogHub (bloghub.app) is a free directory of blogs, newsletters, and Substack publications. Writers submit their publication to get discovered by readers and earn a link back; there is no listing fee and no subscriber minimum. Built by Firebird Technologies.

## What it does

- Lists blogs, newsletters, and Substack publications by category, each with its own publication page.
- Lets writers submit a blog or newsletter for free.
- Publishes guides on growing a blog or newsletter and on choosing a platform.
- Offers free blog-name and newsletter-name generators.

## Key pages

- [Submit your newsletter](https://bloghub.app/submit-your-newsletter): free submission form for a blog, newsletter, or Substack.
- [Free tools](https://bloghub.app/tools): blog name generator and newsletter name generator.
- [Blog name generator](https://bloghub.app/tools/blog-name-generator)
- [Newsletter name generator](https://bloghub.app/tools/newsletter-name-generator)
- [All guides](https://bloghub.app/blogs)

- [Best newsletter platforms](https://bloghub.app/blogs/best-newsletter-platforms)
- [Best newsletter directories](https://bloghub.app/blogs/best-newsletter-directories)
- [Best blog directories](https://bloghub.app/blogs/best-blog-directories)
- [Article submission sites](https://bloghub.app/blogs/article-submission-sites)
- [How to submit your blog to directories](https://bloghub.app/blogs/how-to-submit-your-blog-to-directories)
- [How to promote your blog for free](https://bloghub.app/blogs/how-to-promote-your-blog-for-free)
- [How to get your first 1,000 blog readers](https://bloghub.app/blogs/how-to-get-your-first-1000-blog-readers)
- [How to start a newsletter](https://bloghub.app/blogs/how-to-start-a-newsletter)
- [How to grow on Substack](https://bloghub.app/blogs/how-to-grow-on-substack)
- [Best blogging platforms](https://bloghub.app/blogs/best-blogging-platforms)

## Sister products

- [Blog2Video](https://blog2video.app): turns blog posts, URLs, and PDFs into narrated videos.
- [PDF2Video](https://pdf2vid.com): turns PDFs and documents into narrated videos.
